description: This file implements a dialog input box component for a terminal-based UI, including functions for rendering buttons, handling user input, and managing dialog window behavior within a curses-like environment.

methods.name: void print_buttons(WINDOW * dialog,int height,int width,int selected)
methods.description: Renders the 'Ok' and 'Help' buttons at the bottom of the dialog window, highlighting the selected button.

methods.name: int dialog_inputbox(const char * title,const char * prompt,int height,int width,const char * init)
methods.description: Displays a centered dialog box with a prompt, an input field initial value, and 'Ok'/'Help' buttons; handles user interaction for text input and button selection.

ctags.name: dialog_inputbox
ctags.pattern: /^int dialog_inputbox(const char *title, const char *prompt, int height, int width,$/
ctags.signature: (const char * title,const char * prompt,int height,int width,const char * init)

ctags.name: print_buttons
ctags.pattern: /^static void print_buttons(WINDOW * dialog, int height, int width, int selected)$/
